reason: A client-side DSH web plugin for selecting conversation text, adding comments, and inserting anchored quote chips that navigate back to highlighted source content.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DSH 会话中选中文字并添加批注，将内容作为可回跳原文的锚点引用插入输入框。
summaries.en: A DSH web plugin for annotating selected conversation text and inserting anchored quotes that link back to the highlighted source.

capabilities: captures selected conversation text for user-created annotations
inserts anchored quote chips into the conversation input
serializes selected quotes and comments into structured conversation context
provides navigation from quote chips back to highlighted source text
stores quote mappings in browser memory during the page session
